location.basis: Wikipedia coordinates (29.59833 N, 75.39194 E) fall on an oval, grass-covered protected mound of about 6 ha surrounded by fields; the coordinates are those of the mound centre in Esri World Imagery.

sources.citation_or_service: Esri World Imagery tile service, https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}; Source: Esri, Vantor, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS User Community
sources.north_label_text: Web Mercator grid north (true north at every point; north up)

main_system_reason: No Harappan line could be identified in the imagery.
notes: The mound is backfilled and grassed. Its surface shows only visitor tracks (a perimeter track and several crossing tracks) and one small modern square near the centre; no Harappan wall, street or fortification is visible in the current image or in the archived releases of 2021 to 2025 that we inspected. The fields around the mound follow the cardinal canal-colony grid and were not used.

diagnostics.method: see METHOD.md; deviation peaks from magnitude-weighted gradient-direction histograms folded modulo 90 degrees
